newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Australia to review its public service.
newsitem.headline: Australia to review its public service.

text.p: Australian Industrial Relations Minister Peter Reith said on Monday the government would conduct a major review of the Australian Public Service (APS).
"We would like to see the public service reach better levels in terms of productivity and service delivery," Reith told reporters.
"There is this constant pressure on the public sector to be more competitive, to be more productive," Reith said.
Public servants had been denied opportunities to develop their talents because of the the bureaucratic system used to operate the APS, he said.
The conservative Liberal-National government would review the public service legislation and redraft it early in the new year.
The government has already moved to improve labour market efficiency. Parliament passed the government's labour reforms last week, promising more jobs and faster economic growth.
The government has said the deregulation of the labour market would emphasise a freer market reducing the role of unions.
